study_identification_part.si_4_title: Accommodating Site Variation In Neuroimaging Data Using Normative And Hierarchical Bayesian Models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE healthy controls and autism sample.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: “We used the healthy control sample from the ABIDE (autism brain imaging data exchange...) ... Subsequently, we validate the hierarchical Bayesian models in the autism sample of the ABIDE data set”

answer.ABIDE: healthy controls for normative model development and performance testing (train/test split); autism sample for clinical validation/test

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Controls used for model development/performance testing with 70% training and 30% test split; autism sample used for validation of clinically useful variance.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: “For this study, we used 569 controls for development and performance testing of the models... In a subsequent step, we applied the hierarchical Bayesian models to 482 individuals with autism from the same data set” ... “we split the the healthy control data set into a training set (70% of data, n=389) and a test set (30% of data, n=166)”
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / 3.1.1 ABIDE data set; Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / 3.3 Splitting the ABIDE data set into training and test sets

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Both normative models trained on the same ABIDE healthy controls; train/test split applied to controls.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: “For this study, we used 569 controls for development and performance testing of the models” ... “we split the the healthy control data set into a training set (70% of data, n=389) and a test set (30% of data, n=166)”
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / 3.1.1 ABIDE data set; Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / 3.3 Splitting the ABIDE data set into training and test sets

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall control mean/sd computed as weighted mean and pooled SD from male/female control age stats; min/max from control age range.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: “Controls : Age male subjects: M = 17.5., SD = 8.3. Age female subjects: M = 15.6, SD = 7.0., range = 6.5-40”

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female count inferred as total controls minus males.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: “For this study, we used 569 controls for development and performance testing of the models, out of which 470 were male.”
